notes:
v0.9.0 — September 12, 2026

New Interface & Pinnable Overlays

The biggest update so far. The main window was rebuilt around pages instead of
one crowded screen, overlays can now stay on as live instruments, and the fuel
strategy got a real correction to how it measures the distance ahead. Most of
this came out of running the app in real races and finding where it fell short.

Interface

The main window is now organised into five pages — Fuel, Tires, History,
Overlays and Settings — reached from a side rail, replacing the row of header
buttons and the three-card grid.
Fuel is the page that opens first.
Added a fuel chart covering the whole race: the measured curve lap by lap, the
projected line to the chequered flag, the safety margin band, and a marker where
you pitted.
The fuel page now has two states. During a race it shows the recommendation, the
numbers behind it and the chart. With the sim closed it shows your past races at
that car and track instead of an empty screen.
Race History became a page inside the app. The separate History window was
removed.
Added a Tires page showing accumulated wear on a top-down car diagram, plus
which tyre-change options the app has enough samples to reason about and which
it does not.
Added an Overlays page and a Settings page, gathering controls that were
previously spread across the header and JSON files.
The app now uses the .NET native dark theme, and the same embedded typefaces as
the website across every window.
Font sizes now follow a single scale instead of eleven ad-hoc values.
The title bar is now dark, matching the rest of the app.

Overlays

Pinning an overlay now means instrument mode: it stays on screen showing live
information every tick, instead of only appearing when there is a warning.
The Overlays page lets you pin or unpin each overlay, recentre it, and see its
saved position and which monitor it is on — without waiting for an alert to fire
so you can grab it.
Fixed the pin on the fuel overlay doing nothing at all. The behaviour existed but
was never connected, so pinning it and closing it left it hidden for the rest of
the race.
Overlay state is now shown as a 3px accent bar at the top instead of recolouring
the entire frame.
The number you actually need is now its own field rather than buried inside a
sentence.
The pin never suppresses a critical warning: an urgent message still takes the
overlay, and the instrument returns on the next tick.

Fuel strategy

Fuel now plans for the distance the car still has to burn, instead of counting
whole laps still to start. The old behaviour could under-fuel the final stop.
Separated what the car needs to finish from what it should carry, so the safety
margin stops being folded into the requirement.
The consumption estimate, the remaining distance and the safety margin now each
record which source produced them, and that reaches the log.
Fixed the fuel-save alert firing at the very target the app itself had asked for.
Fixed the app telling you to save fuel while also telling you there was enough.
The app now tells you how much to lift while lifting still helps, rather than
only that you should.
Fixed a fuel prediction surviving past the session it described.
The reduced-margin notice no longer borrows the wording of a STAY OUT call.
The pit call no longer explains itself with a number it did not use.

Notifications

One state change now produces one message. Overlapping and duplicate
notifications were arbitrated away.
When a safety warning speaks, the narrative messages stay silent until it is
done.
Fixed the unknown-phase caveat reading as boilerplate on nearly every history
row.

Race History

A recorded session is now an iRacing session, not an app run. Practice,
qualifying and the race no longer land in one row.
Strategy figures are calculated from races, and the app states how much of the
sample predates that separation.
Added the recorded fuel curve for each session, with a note explaining how to
read it.
Added fuel delivered and time in pit lane for the selected session.
Lap counts are no longer inflated by laps recorded twice, and pit-stop counts no
longer include pit-lane entries made before the first lap.
The idle fuel page lists races rather than every session, so the summary figures
match the table above them.
Pit stops now stay open long enough to receive their stint tyre wear.
Fixed the four summary figures staying blank after choosing a car and track.

Fixes

Tyre wear no longer displays as 0.0% when it has not been measured. This was
happening on three separate screens.
Fixed two different decimal separators appearing on the same screen.
Fixed an internal identifier reaching the driver, in both languages.
Fixed a page showing its column headers in one language and everything else in
another.
Fixed the window reporting "I don't know" in the colour reserved for "all good".
Fixed the fuel level disappearing from the screen at the start of a race, before
the first strategy decision existed.
Fixed labels showing the wrong quantity: range was showing a sample count, and
consumption per lap was showing litres per hour.
Fixed closing a session failing silently and leaving an unfinished row in the
history database.
